cases.case_label: 3 kb founder retrotransposal insertion in fukutin (FKTN) causing Fukuyama congenital muscular dystrophy
cases.mechanism_detail: From review: a 3 kb retrotransposal insertion in the fukutin gene on chromosome 9q31 is the ancestral founder mutation carried by 87% of FCMD chromosomes in Japan, with two independent point mutations on non-founder haplotypes. The element class and the molecular consequence on the transcript are not stated.
cases.quote: Most FCMD-bearing chromosomes are derived from a single ancestral founder (87%), and a 3kb-retrotransposal insertion was found to be a founder mutation.
